live.offline: offline — changes wait to be sent

noAccess.title: You don't have access to inquiries
noAccess.body: Sales see and answer inquiries (Sales › Inquiries). Ask your administrator for the sales role if you need them.

list.intro: New requests and RFQs from mail, the portal, the phone, a fair or a visit, until they become a quote. The oldest waiting first.
list.rulesLaterHint: Comes later: inquiries are given by hand for now
list.countCapped: The first {count} inquiries: narrow the filters to see the rest
list.noMatchBody: Change or clear the filters to see more inquiries.
list.emptyBody: No inquiries. A mail from a customer becomes one from Mail to sort ("Make an inquiry"); a phone call or a visit with New inquiry.
list.foot: Waiting counts working time on the company calendar; over one working day it turns red. A list never names a person: "You" or "A colleague".

row.openNewTab: Open full page in a new tab

keys.quote: Make quote (the focused or selected inquiry, or the open one)

tile.WAITING_US: Waiting for us over 1 working day

hint.WAITING_US: New or in progress, on the working calendar

tile.partial: Counted on the oldest 1000 open inquiries

notice.label: Notices
notice.partial: More than 1000 inquiries are open: "Waiting for us over 1 working day" counts only the oldest 1000.
notice.capped: The list shows the first {count} inquiries of these filters: narrow them to see the rest.
notice.prospects_one: {count} open inquiry is from a prospect: match it to a customer (Request) before a quote.
notice.prospects_other: {count} open inquiries are from prospects: match each to a customer (Request) before a quote.

waiting.usOverdue: Waiting for us over 1 working day

bulk.noneOpen: Only open inquiries can be assigned or declined

held.right: Your role does not allow this ({right})
held.offline: Offline — this waits until the connection is back
held.offlineKept: Offline — your changes are kept on this page
held.notNow: Not possible for this inquiry now

refusal.CLOSED: {number} is closed: only its note can change
refusal.NOT_WAITING: {number} does not wait for the customer
refusal.NEEDS_CUSTOMER: {number} is from a prospect: match it to a customer first (Request) — a quote is made for a customer
refusal.OTHER_NEEDS_WORDS: Say in words why it is declined (the reason is Other)
refusal.MAIL_TAKEN: This mail was already made into {number}
refusal.QUOTE_TAKEN: This quote was already made from another inquiry
refusal.MAIL_NOT_WAITING: Only a mail that was read (in Mail to sort, or in a thread) becomes an inquiry

problem.unavailable: The factory cannot be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
problem.notFound: It is not there any more (or not in this company)
problem.signedOut: You were signed out: sign in again
problem.contract: The factory answered in a way this page does not read: reload the page
problem.rateLimited: Too many requests at once: wait a moment and try again
problem.stale: Someone changed it a moment ago: it was read again — check and try again
problem.staleSome: Some of these inquiries changed a moment ago: the list was read again — select them and try again
problem.invalid: Something typed does not fit: see the fields named below

record.notFoundBody: This inquiry is not there any more, or it belongs to another company or customer you do not see.
record.offline: Offline — the inquiry as last read; Apply and every verb wait for the connection
record.stale: Someone changed this inquiry at {time}: reload to see it (your typing is kept until then)

verb.askInfoHint: It waits for the customer; write to them in Activity

done.askInfo: {number} waits for the customer: write to them here in Activity
done.messageSent: The message was sent to {to} (in Activity)
done.messageFailed: The message was not sent: write it again in Activity
done.quoteWarnings_one: {quote} made from {number}: {count} thing to check on the quote
done.quoteWarnings_other: {quote} made from {number}: {count} things to check on the quote

closed.noteOnly: A closed inquiry changes no more: only its note.

who.title: Who asks
who.erased: Erased prospect (their personal data was removed)
who.unknown: Unknown sender — match to a customer
who.unknownBody: A quote is made for a customer: match this prospect to one (once), or make the customer in Sales › Customers first.
who.matchHint: Once matched, the customer stays: the mail joins its conversation

problem.who: Say who asks: a name, a company or an e-mail address
problem.email: The e-mail address does not read as one
problem.phone: A phone number: digits, spaces and ( ) . / -, an optional + first

basis.CONTRACT: Steps at their request (a request for a quote)

request.requestHint: As they said it; the lines below are the same request, structured
request.targetHint: The price the customer named; a price, shown only with the price right
request.linesHint: Turn free text into lines: pick a style per product asked
request.noteHint: For us only; it can change even once the inquiry is closed

problem.request: Say what they ask, in words
problem.price: The target price does not read as an amount (12,50 or 12.50)

line.title: Line {n}
line.pickStyle: Pick a style, or describe it in words
line.inWords: Not a style of ours: in words
line.colourTextHint: As the customer said it ("dark navy")
line.descriptionHint: A product we do not have as a style yet: say it in words
line.descriptionStyleHint: Anything the customer adds to the style (optional)
line.quantityHint: When the sizes are not known yet
line.none: No lines yet: the request in words is enough to start; add lines to make a quote from it.
line.noneAsked: No lines: the request is in words only.
line.noStylesRight: Your role does not read the styles: describe the products in words
line.styleFailed: Couldn't read this style's sizes and colourways

problem.styleOrWords: Pick a style, or say in words what is asked
problem.sizes: The sizes do not read: size:pieces, e.g. 50:5 52:10
problem.tooManySizes: At most {max} sizes on a line
problem.quantitySum: The pieces in all are the sum of the sizes ({total})

mail.title: The sender's mail, as sent
mail.subject: Subject
mail.waits: A prospect’s mail waits in Mail to sort until the inquiry is matched to a customer; then it joins the conversation.

pack.title: The brand's tech pack
pack.hint: Carried to the quote and the order: always the version in force
pack.version: Tech pack version (as the brand names it)
pack.none: No tech pack files named yet: tick them among the files.
pack.newer: Version {named} named; version {current} is in force now
pack.gone: No version of this file is available now
pack.choose: Files of the inquiry and its mail
pack.chooseHint: Tick the files that are the tech pack; Apply keeps the choice

files.none: No files yet: add them below, or they come with the mail.
files.noRight: Your role does not read the inquiry's files and conversation

problem.type: This kind of file cannot be added

quote.noneBody: Make quote copies {lines} line(s) with their sizes; {left} left out (no style, colourway or sizes).
quote.noneProspect: A quote is made for a customer: match the prospect to a customer on Request first.
quote.noRight: Your role does not read quotes
quote.oneOnly: One inquiry becomes one quote; its later revisions are on the quote.
quote.title: Make quote
quote.promiseHint: The target date, when it is ahead
quote.copiedLabel: Lines that go to the quote
quote.emptyDraft: No line names a style in a colourway with sizes: the quote starts empty (a draft to fill in).
quote.closes: Lines are priced at the customer’s price list, else 0. The inquiry closes as Quoted and shows its quote.

leftOut.noStyle: Line {n}: no style picked — add it on the quote
leftOut.noColourway: Line {n}: no colourway picked — add it on the quote
leftOut.noSizes: Line {n}: no pieces by size — add the sizes on the quote
leftOut.size: Line {n}: size {size} is not offered in that colourway any more

activity.none: Nothing yet. The first change or message appears here.
activity.noRight: Your role does not read the inquiry's conversation

assign.title: Assign
assign.noPeople: Nobody here keeps inquiries: an administrator gives the sales role.
assign.partial: Only the first people are listed: search a name.
assign.hint: ↑ ↓ to choose, Enter to give it. People are listed by name; nobody is counted.

decline.title: Decline inquiry

hint.CAPACITY: We cannot make it in the time they need
hint.LEAD_TIME: The date they want is too close
hint.NOT_OUR_PRODUCT: We do not make this kind of product
hint.PRICE: Their target price is out of reach

decline.noteOther: Needed when the reason is Other
decline.messageTo: Sent to {to} through the inquiry’s conversation, after the decline

message.many: A message goes to one customer at a time: write from each inquiry’s Activity
message.prospect: A prospect has no customer conversation yet: answer their mail from Mail to sort
message.noEmail: The inquiry names no contact with an e-mail: pick one on Request first

decline.final: A closed inquiry changes no more (only its note).

lost.title: Mark as lost
lost.noteHint: In words; kept on the inquiry

new.title: New inquiry
new.subtitle: A phone call, a visit, a fair, or a portal request recorded by hand
new.fromMailTitle: Make an inquiry from this mail
new.whoProspectHint: Not a customer yet: matched to one before the quote
new.noCustomersRight: Your role does not read the customers: record a prospect
new.prospectBasis: Kept as steps at their request (a request for a quote, GDPR art. 6(1)(b)).
new.requestHint: What they ask, as they said it
new.requestFromMail: The mail's subject and text; change it if you like
new.filesHint: Tech packs, sketches, photos: added once the inquiry is made (for us only; share them later from Files & specs)
new.filesNoRight: Your role does not add files
new.fileLater: Added once the inquiry is made
new.mailStays: The mail and its attachments stay with the inquiry.
new.mailContact: The sender is a contact of {name}
new.mailDomain: The sender writes from the domain of {name}
new.mailProspect: Nexus does not know the sender: a prospect, from the mail’s From
new.mailGone: This mail is not there any more, or your role does not sort the mail

held.customer: Pick the customer, or record a prospect
held.request: Say what they ask, in words

new.doneFiles_one: {number} made; {count} file was not added: add it on Files & specs
new.doneFiles_other: {number} made; {count} files were not added: add them on Files & specs
